info.title: bluetooth-bridge MQTT API
info.description:
Everything bluetooth-bridge publishes and accepts on MQTT.

Topics here use the default base topic, `bluetooth` (`mqtt.base_topic` in the configuration), and Home Assistant's default discovery prefix, `homeassistant` (`homeassistant.discovery_prefix`). `{address}` is a device's address as twelve upper-case hex digits, most significant first (`BC5729000001`).

The bridge subscribes at QoS 1. It publishes its availability, its info and its own Home Assistant device at QoS 1, and everything that follows the radio (advertisements, readings, events, responses) at QoS 0, so a slow broker never stalls the scan. Payloads are JSON unless a message says otherwise; byte strings in them are lower-case hex. Requests go to `bluetooth/bridge/request/<name>`; the answer comes on `bluetooth/bridge/response/<name>`, echoing the request's `transaction` so a client can match the two. Keys never appear on MQTT.

broker.description: Your MQTT broker: `mqtt.host` and `mqtt.port` in the configuration. The bridge connects with a clean session, its `mqtt.client_id`, and `bluetooth/bridge/state` set to offline as its last will.

bridgeState.description: The bridge's availability, retained. `offline` is also the bridge's last will.

bridgeInfo.description: The bridge and its controller, retained.

bridgeEvent.description: Connections, pairing, notifications, writes to the bridge's GATT server and periodic advertising reports, as they happen. `type` names the event.

meshEvent.description: Unprovisioned devices heard and access messages to the bridge. Only with `mesh.enabled`. `type` names the event.

scanReport.description: Every advertisement after duplicate filtering, parsed, with any beacon or sensor frames decoded. Only with `scan.publish_reports`.

address.description: The device's address: twelve upper-case hex digits, most significant first; its identity when a stored IRK resolves a private address.

deviceState.description: A device's decoded readings, for devices whose advertisements carry any (BTHome, KKM, Ruuvi, Eddystone TLM). Home Assistant's entities read it.

address.description: The device's address: twelve upper-case hex digits, most significant first; its identity when a stored IRK resolves a private address.

scanStartRequest.description: Start scanning, or restart it with another configuration.

connectRequest.description: Connect to a device as central.

connectionPhyRequest.description: Ask for other PHYs on a connection.

connectionDataLengthRequest.description: Set the largest packets the bridge sends on a connection.

gattMtuRequest.description: Exchange the ATT MTU with a peer.

gattDiscoverRequest.description: Discover a peer's services, characteristics and descriptors.

gattSubscribeRequest.description: Turn a peer characteristic's notifications or indications on or off. They arrive as `notification` events.

secureRequest.description: Encrypt a link with a stored key, pairing when there is none.

bondsRequest.description: The stored bonds: who, and what kind of keys. Keys are never published.

advertiseDataRequest.description: Change a set's data while it advertises.

periodicStartRequest.description: Start periodic advertising on an extended set.

periodicSyncRequest.description: Follow another device's periodic advertising train. Its reports arrive as `periodic_report` events.

periodicTerminateRequest.description: Stop following a periodic advertising train.

serverAddRequest.description: Add a service to the bridge's GATT server.

serverSetRequest.description: Set a value in the bridge's GATT server, and optionally notify its subscribers.

serverGetRequest.description: Read a value from the bridge's GATT server.

meshNetworkRequest.description: The mesh network: the bridge's address, the IV index and the nodes it provisioned. Mesh requests need `mesh.enabled`.

meshUnprovisionedRequest.description: The unprovisioned devices whose beacons were heard, newest first.

meshProvisionRequest.description: Provision a device into the network. Waits up to two minutes.

meshConfigureRequest.description: Give a node the application key, bind its models and read its Composition Data. Waits up to a minute.

meshOnoffRequest.description: Switch a node's Generic OnOff server. Waits up to 30 seconds for its status.

homeAssistantDiscovery.description: Home Assistant MQTT discovery: one retained config per reading of a device, sent the first time the bridge hears the reading and again when Home Assistant comes online, and one for the bridge's own connection state. Only with `homeassistant.enabled`.

node_id.description: `bluetooth_` and the device's address in lower case, or the bridge's id: `bluetooth_bridge` for the default base topic.

object_id.description: The reading: `temperature`, `battery`, `rssi` and so on, or `connection_state` for the bridge.

homeAssistantStatus.description: Home Assistant's birth and last will (`homeassistant.status_topic`). When it says `online`, the bridge publishes discovery again.

publishBridgeState.summary: The bridge is online or offline
publishBridgeState.description: Published `online` on connecting and `offline` on stopping.

publishBridgeInfo.summary: The bridge's version and its controller

publishScanReport.description: Published for each advertisement that passes `scan.min_rssi` and `scan.allow`.

publishDeviceState.description: Published after each advertisement with readings.

publishDiscovery.description: Published per entity: the bridge's own at QoS 1, a device's at QoS 0.

le_supported_features.description: LE Supported Features (bit mask, octet 0 first).

sm_tk.description: Security Manager TK Value (legacy OOB pairing).

sm_oob_flags.description: Security Manager Out of Band Flags.

ssp_hash.description: Simple Pairing Hash C-192 or C-256 (BR/EDR OOB), the last one seen.

ssp_randomizer.description: Simple Pairing Randomizer R-192 or R-256, the last one seen.

other.description:
Every other structure, by type, with its SIG name: Mesh, BIGInfo,
Indoor Positioning, Transport Discovery, Encrypted Advertising Data,
unassigned types, and any field whose length was wrong for its type.

malformed.description:
Set when a structure's length ran past the end of the data; every
structure before it was still read.

Advertisement.description:
Every field an advertisement (or a scan response, or both concatenated)
can carry, read into typed values.

A field whose length is wrong for its type is kept in [`Advertisement::other`]
instead, so nothing the device sent is lost.

le_br_edr_controller.description: Simultaneous LE and BR/EDR to Same Device Capable (Controller).

complete.description: Whether it came from a complete list (rather than an incomplete one).

ServiceUuid.description: A service UUID listed in the advertisement.

Uuid.description: A UUID: four hex digits for a 16-bit one (`180f`), eight for 32-bit, or the full 128-bit form (`0000180f-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb`).

name.description: The name, with invalid UTF-8 replaced.

complete.description: Complete Local Name (rather than Shortened Local Name).

vendor_id_source.description: 1: Bluetooth SIG company identifier, 2: USB Implementer's Forum vendor id.

DeviceId.description: The Device ID AD type (EIR): who made the device and which product it is.

name.description: The SIG's name for the UUID.

ServiceData.description: Service data: a UUID and the bytes the service defines.

company.description: The company it is assigned to.

ManufacturerData.description: Manufacturer specific data: a company identifier and the company's bytes.

RawAd.description:
An AD structure kept as bytes: a type this crate names but whose contents
belong to another layer (Mesh, LE Audio, ...), or a type the SIG has not
assigned yet.

offset.description: Offset of the structure whose length runs past the end of the data.

Malformed.description: Where an advertisement stopped making sense.

Beacon.description: A decoded beacon or sensor frame.

measured_power.description: Measured power: RSSI at one metre, dBm.

beacon_id.description: Beacon id: by convention a 16-byte organisational unit then 4 bytes.

reference_rssi.description: Average RSSI at one metre, dBm.

tx_power.description: Calibrated TX power at 0 m, dBm.
Calibrated TX power at 0 m, dBm.

battery_mv.description: Battery voltage, mV; `None` when the beacon does not measure it.

adv_count.description: Advertising PDUs sent since power-on or reboot.

uptime.description: Time since power-on or reboot, seconds (0.1 s resolution).

oneOf.description: Eddystone-TLM (0x20), version 0: telemetry in the clear.

tx_power.description: Calibrated TX power at 0 m, dBm.

name.description: BTHome's name for it, snake case: `temperature`, `door`, ...

value.description: The value, scaled. Binary sensors are 0 or 1.

steps.description: For a dimmer, the number of steps.

index.description: Which button or dimmer, counting from 1 in the order they appear.

undecryptable.description:
The frame was encrypted and could not be decrypted: no key, a wrong
key, or no address to build the nonce from. Nothing else is set.

counter.description:
The encryption counter, when encrypted. A receiver should reject a
counter that does not increase.

trigger_based.description: The device sends at irregular intervals (on a button press, say).

packet_id.description: The packet id (object 0x00): the same id twice is a repeat.

unknown_object.description: The first object id this decoder does not know; decoding stopped there.

truncated.description: The frame ended inside an object.

undecryptable.description:
Encrypted, and no password (or no address) to decrypt it with. When
the password is wrong the readings are garbage: KKM's format has no
integrity check.

model.description: Device model (v2 sensor and system frames).

axis.description: Three-axis reading (accelerometer in mg, or magnetometer on the S7S).

alarm.description:
Alarm byte. Its bits are model specific; on the S7S parking sensor
bits 0-1 are park status and bits 4-5 radar status.

voc.description: VOC index, and seconds since it was measured.

co2.description: CO2, ppm, and seconds since it was measured.

new_records.description: New history records: record type and count.

utc.description: UTC seconds sent with an encrypted frame.

mac.description: The beacon's own MAC address, as printed (system frames).
The MAC address the tag reports, as printed.

Ruuvi.description: A Ruuvi frame's values, in SI-ish units.

name.description: The device's local name, or its address.

manufacturer.description: The company in its manufacturer data, when known.

sw_version.description: The bridge's version, for the bridge.

via_device.description: The bridge the device is heard through.

DiscoveryDevice.description: The device an entity belongs to.

le_features.description: The LE features the controller supports, by name.

active.description: Send scan requests to get scan responses.

window_ms.description: Scan window, ms (no more than the interval).

coded.description: Scan on the coded PHY too (long range), when the controller can.

filter_accept_list.description: Only devices on the filter accept list.

always_report.description:
AD types whose advertisements are reported every time, whatever
`dedup` says: a protocol carried in advertisements, such as Mesh
(`0x29` to `0x2b`), whose retransmissions are identical and must not
be filtered as duplicates.

Dedup.description: How to treat repeats of the same advertisement.

oneOf.description: Report a device again only when its data changes.

Report when its data changes, and at least every this many
milliseconds while it is heard (so presence and RSSI stay current).

Done.description: An empty result: the request is done.

timeout_ms.description: Give up after this long, ms.

handle.description: The connection handle, which requests on the connection name.

primary.description: Primary (rather than secondary, found through an include).

end.description: The last handle in the service.

Service.description: A service on a peer's server.

value_handle.description: The value's handle (what reads and writes address).

end.description: The last handle belonging to the characteristic.

Characteristic.description: A characteristic on a peer's server.

Descriptor.description: A descriptor on a peer's server.

removed.description: A bond was stored and is gone.

label.description: The label it was stored with, if any.

has_irk.description: The peer's identity resolving key is stored.

authenticated.description: The keys came from a pairing with MITM protection.

secure_connections.description: The keys came from LE Secure Connections.

BondInfo.description: A stored bond: who, and what kind of keys, never the keys.

scannable.description: Answer scan requests with the scan response.

legacy.description:
Use legacy PDUs (seen by every scanner, 31 octets of data). `None`
chooses: legacy when the data fits and nothing needs Bluetooth 5.

high_duty.description: High duty cycle directed advertising (lasts 1.28 s at most).

include_tx_power.description: Put the TX power in the extended header.

tx_power.description: TX power to ask for, dBm; `None` lets the controller choose.

sid.description: Advertising set id (0 to 15), as scanners see it.

filter_accept_list.description: Only answer scan and connection requests from the filter accept list.

set.description: The set's handle, which later requests on it name.

include_tx_power.description: Put the TX power in each packet.

PeriodicParams.description: A periodic advertising train on a set.

max_len.description: The longest value a client may write (at most 512).

Access.description: Who may read or write an attribute.

oneOf.description: An encrypted link with an authenticated (MITM-protected) key.
Authenticated LE Secure Connections with a 128-bit key.

characteristics.description: Each characteristic's value handle, in the order given.

ServiceHandles.description: The handles of an added service.

notified.description: How many clients were notified or indicated, with `notify`.

value.description: The value, hex, or `null` when there is no such attribute.

elements.description: How many elements it has (addresses `address` onwards).

heard.description: When its beacon was last heard, seconds since the Unix epoch.

UnprovisionedDevice.description: An unprovisioned device whose beacon was heard.

company_name.description: The company, by the Bluetooth SIG's name, when known.

friend.description: Can be a friend to low-power nodes.

location.description: Its location, a GATT Namespace Descriptor.

MeshModel.description: A model: a SIG model, or a vendor's.

company_name.description: The vendor, by the Bluetooth SIG's name, when known.

id.description: The model id, four hex digits.
The model id, four hex digits.

name.description: The SIG's name for it, when known.
